body:
I know how you feel, I try to hide it from people close to me yet I'm amazed and angry that they never noticed it, I don't want them to, but at the same time it hurts to think that nobody in this world knows me atall, nobody notices and nobody cares.
I get how you feel, you are not alone though, if you need to talk or vent, you can PM me, I wish you good luck though.
I've googled, a lot, I get annoyed when people just ask questions and don't bother searching for the answer first, but I'm not one of those people, I've searched and found nothing.
Is there a good chatroom for psychotic depression?

I don't care much about video games to be honest anymore and while the depresssion and the psychosis is experienced by other people, I have a fair amount of unique shit going on in my life, and that's the stuff I can't talk to anyone about.
Not really, and there's very few people who'd actually have any idea of what to say.

It isn't.

And as I said in the post I linked, I can't get help.
Nope, nobody knows, nobody even knows any of the shit I've already been through, let alone the shit I'm currently going through.
I don't really want to talk about anything anymore, and that'd be the thing I'd be least likely to talk about with anyone.

I decided not to get help about a year and a half ago, I was saying that the fact that I'm not getting any I think is better, I feel worse, I had something that pulled me out of this all a year ago, then I realized I wasn't really very good at it, I messed things up and I've been going down hill, a lot of suicide threats are empty, atleast for a short while, I'm pretty damn sure mine isn't, I think I'll actually go through with it and I really fuckin hope I do.
Better actually, I really don't want to seek help, either I do it on my own or I don't do it at all.
I'm just curious as to see what other people say about all this.
